entry_proxy: open of the 15:49 start-stamped minute bar
exit_proxy: close of the 15:50 start-stamped minute bar
execution_buffer: one full minute between final feature bar and 15:49 entry proxy
primary_mechanism: down-to-small deletion confirmation using direction-signed stock-minus-SPY return from 14:48 open through 15:47 close
candidate_family_rationale: one-dimensional soft attenuation of the already identified weak down-to-small deletion leg; day/hour conjunctions are diagnostics and cannot be selected by the primary optimizer
weighting: multiply only unconfirmed down-to-small deletion weights by the declared retention fraction, then scale only the larger surviving leg down to dollar neutrality; never raise any name above its original 10 percent cap
missing_feature_policy: fail closed for every non-baseline rule
familywise_control: four-review block sign-flip max-t across all six non-baseline fixed rules

walk_forward.nonpositive_baseline_policy: candidate training net return must be positive and no worse than baseline
walk_forward.selection_tie_breaker: lowest intervention rank then lexicographic rule name

robustness.no_purging_needed_reason: quarterly event labels are non-overlapping one-minute windows; chronological expanding folds remain mandatory

future_holdout.start: first official MSCI implementation close after 2026-08-31
future_holdout.primary_comparison: optimized challenger versus matched baseline at 10 bp
